faq.label: BEFORE WE BEGIN
faq.heading: A few things
faq.description: A little clarity for your next step.

items.question: What can TERVYX help me with?
items.answer: Our core services are web development, app development, and digital marketing. We can discuss one focused project or how those disciplines could work together for your business.

items.question: Can I start with just an idea?
items.answer: Yes. Share the problem you want to solve, who you want to reach, and what you hope to achieve. You do not need a finished specification to begin the conversation.

items.question: Can you work on an existing website or app?
items.answer: We can review your current experience and discuss improvements. The scope will depend on the existing technology, the access available, and the changes you want to make.

items.question: How are project cost and timing decided?
items.answer: They depend on the scope, complexity, content, integrations, and priorities of your project. We discuss those details before agreeing on an approach; there is no one-size-fits-all estimate.

items.question: Will my website work on mobile devices?
items.answer: Responsive behavior is part of our web development approach. Layouts should adapt to different screen sizes, with readable content, usable navigation, and clear actions on phones, tablets, and desktops.

items.question: What should I include in my project brief?
items.answer: Tell us about your business, the service you need, your audience, the problem you want to solve, and any timing or budget constraints. The Contact page lets you create a brief to save and share; it does not send an enquiry automatically.
